Subject: Update on Your Application for the Marketing Position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for applying for the Marketing position at our company. We appreciate the time and effort you put into your application.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience aligns more closely with our current needs. Please know that this decision is not a reflection of your skills or qualifications, which we found to be strong.

We wish you the very best in your job search and future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
